name: kit-setup
title_zh: 新机器认领整套工作区，写环境变量前先问你要指哪台服务
tagline_zh: 换电脑最怕配置散落一地。它替你写 kit.env、从模板生成 CLAUDE.md 并自检。
tagline_en: New machine, same homelab. It writes kit.env, generates CLAUDE.md from template, verifies, and asks once which.
desc_en: Configure this kit for your own forge, tracker, and project layout — writes ~/.claude/kit.env, generates your CLAUDE.md from the template, and verifies the result. Use when adopting the kit on a new machine or pointing it at different infrastructure.
why_zh: 不是复制粘贴脚本，而是把「机器身份」和「基建地址」拆成两步：先认领再生成。
why_en: Separates machine identity from infra addresses: adopt first, then generate. No silent template edits that miss a repo path.
limit_zh: 只认 jhjacobson/agent-homelab 的目录约定；不处理 SSH 密钥。
limit_en: Only for jhjacobson/agent-homelab layout. No SSH keys, cloud creds, or Docker networks. Non-Gitea/Vikunja services cause hard exit.
title_en: Adopt your forge, tracker & layout on a new machine
